'''2023 European Championship''' was the Players Committee European Championship in Bochum, Germany, 8–10 September 2023. [[Cedrik Vanderhaegen]] finished 1st in Day 2.<ref name="pc">https://www.starwarsccg.org/2023-08-european-championships-bochum-germany-sept-8-10/</ref>

== Format ==

* '''Environment:''' [[Open]]
* '''Site:''' Bochum, Germany
* '''Dates:''' 8–10 September 2023
